# Stage 2I fixtures — SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL COST DATA

Files produced by the **Stage 2I** version of the app (before Stage 2J), kept unchanged so that later
stages can prove they still read older data:

- `SYNTHETIC_BQ.xlsx` — the synthetic conventional BQ (artificial descriptions, dummy figures).
- `SYNTHETIC_BQ.review-backup.json` — a review backup exported by the Stage 2I app in a real
  browser for that file (reviewer "Synthetic Reviewer", one approval). It has no project details,
  because Stage 2I did not have them.

Do not edit these files: they stand for data users already have.
